screen.title: Conversation: Booking a résumé review
screen.prompt: Listen to a conversation between a student and an employee at the career center.

audio.text: Hi, I'd like someone to look at my résumé before Friday. I'm applying for a summer internship.
Our advisers are booked until next Tuesday, I'm afraid. But we have drop-in hours tomorrow from two to four, and you don't need an appointment.
Drop-in hours? Should I just bring a printed copy?
Bring it on your laptop instead, so the adviser can make changes with you right there.

questions.stem: What problem does the student have?
options: He has lost the printed copy of his résumé
He missed the drop-in hours that were held earlier in the week
He does not know which internship to apply for
He needs feedback sooner than an appointment would allow

why.en: Main problem (inference): he needs help "before Friday", but appointments are booked "until next Tuesday". C and A are never mentioned; B confuses the time: drop-in hours are tomorrow.
why.tr: Ana sorun (çıkarım): "Cuma'dan önce" yardım istiyor ama randevular "gelecek Salı'ya kadar" dolu. C ve A hiç geçmiyor; B zamanı karıştırıyor: serbest saatler yarın.
why.es: Problema principal (inferencia): necesita ayuda "before Friday", pero las citas están ocupadas "until next Tuesday". C y A no se mencionan; B confunde el momento: las horas libres son mañana.

questions.stem: What does the woman suggest the student do?
options: Wait for an appointment next Tuesday
Email his résumé to one of the advisers before tonight
Bring his résumé on a computer rather than on paper
Apply for the internship without a review

why.en: Detail (paraphrase of "Bring it on your laptop instead"). A is what she says is the only appointment option, not her advice; B and D are never suggested.
why.tr: Ayrıntı ("Bring it on your laptop instead" ifadesinin parafrazı). A tek randevu seçeneği olarak söylediği şey, önerisi değil; B ve D hiç önerilmiyor.
why.es: Detalle (paráfrasis de "Bring it on your laptop instead"). A es la única cita disponible que menciona, no su consejo; B y D no se proponen.
